command:
set -eu
cat > /var/lib/inventory-chroot/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
umask 027
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT HUP
state=/var/lib/inventory/worker-state
heartbeat=/var/lib/inventory/heartbeat
printf 'running pid=%s uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$$" "$(id -u)" "$(id -g)" > "$state"
while :; do
  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  printf '%s pid=%s\n' "$now" "$$" > "$heartbeat.tmp"
  mv "$heartbeat.tmp" "$heartbeat"
  sleep 5
done
INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF
chown root:root /var/lib/inventory-chroot/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker
chmod 0755 /var/lib/inventory-chroot/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker
if ! grep -Fq '/var/lib/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' '/var/lib/inventory /var/lib/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory none bind,nodev,nosuid,noexec 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
mount --bind /var/lib/inventory /var/lib/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory
mount -o remount,bind,nodev,nosuid,noexec /var/lib/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory
findmnt -no SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /var/lib/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory
tail -1 /etc/fstab
